background: Yorkshire Building Society is the third-largest UK building society, a mutual funded by retail savings under the Yorkshire, Chelsea and Norwich & Peterborough brands and lending on residential mortgages, with Accord as its intermediary lender.
synthesis: Two of the three main agencies rate the society, at A on average, both on a stable outlook, after a one-notch upgrade by one of the three on 12 May 2026. The ratios are strong across the board against UK building societies: CET1 of 19.2% is above the peer median, leverage of 7.1% is in the top quarter, LCR of 229% is above the peer median and NSFR of 158% is in the top quarter. The direction is up as well: since 30 Jun 2025 CET1 has risen 0.7 points, LCR 25 points and NSFR 6 points, with leverage flat. Nothing has been flagged in the last 90 days, making it one of the strongest of the larger societies on both capital and liquidity.
